eyebrow: Microsoft Azure Administration, Compute & Storage · Chapter 5
subtitle: Lesson 17 · Azure Networking

eyebrow: Creating a VNet with a subnet
code:
az network vnet create \
  --resource-group rg-network-demo \
  --name vnet-prod \
  --address-prefix 10.0.0.0/16 \
  --subnet-name snet-web \
  --subnet-prefix 10.0.1.0/24
caption: One call creates both the VNet's address space and its first subnet.

eyebrow: Every subnet, no matter the size

code:
az network vnet subnet create \
  --resource-group rg-network-demo \
  --vnet-name vnet-prod \
  --name snet-app \
  --address-prefixes 10.0.2.0/24
caption: Each new subnet's range must be unique and non-overlapping within the VNet.
